license_type_structure.quote: "Licensed dietitian" means a person licensed under this chapter. "Provisionally licensed dietitian" means a person provisionally licensed under this chapter.

provisional_license_available.quote: The board may issue a provisional license to any resident dietitian who presents evidence to the advisory council of the successful completion of the education and experience requirements of subsections (2) and (3) of this section for licensure.

provisional_license_duration_months.quote: A provisional license may be issued for a period not exceeding one (1) year and may be renewed from year to year not to exceed five (5) years.

provisional_license_requires_supervision.quote: A provisional license shall permit the holder to practice only under the direct technical supervision of a dietitian.

medical_nutrition_therapy_authorized.quote: "Medical nutrition therapy" is a nutritional diagnostic therapy and counseling services for the purpose of disease management.

enteral_parenteral_nutrition_authorized.quote: "Specialized nutrition therapies" mean medical foods, enteral nutrition delivered via tube, or parenteral nutrition delivered by intravenous infusion.

direct_supervision_defined.quote: "Direct, technical supervision" means the direct, technical supervision by a licensed dietitian, as prescribed in regulations by the board, of the dietetics practice or medical nutrition therapy provided to an individual and/or group by a provisionally licensed dietitian.
